examples.english: I saw a musical at the theater.

notes:
{劇場|げきじょう} means theater or playhouse - a venue for live performances such as plays, musicals, and operas.

ETYMOLOGY:
- ⟦{劇|げき}→劇：02713_geki⟧: drama, play
- ⟦{場|じょう}→場：noentry⟧: place, venue

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {劇場|げきじょう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧: to see at the theater
- {劇場|げきじょう}⟦{公開|こうかい}→公開：11665_koukai⟧: theatrical release
- {劇場|げきじょう}⟦{版|ばん}→版：03698_han⟧: theatrical version
- ⟦{国立|こくりつ}→国立：04153_kokuritsu⟧{劇場|げきじょう}: national theater

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {劇場|げきじょう}: theater (for live performances)
- ⟦{映画|えいが}{館|かん}→映画館：01024_eigakan⟧: movie theater
- ⟦ホール→ホール：11169_hooru⟧: hall (concert hall)

- ⟦歌舞伎座→歌舞伎座：noentry⟧: Kabuki-za (Tokyo, kabuki theater)
